info.title: Orders Self-Service API (S7 demo mock)
info.description: A minimal customer self-service Orders API used to demo the Abuse and Scraping Classifier gateway policy. A caller may read only its own order (id 1001 for the demo key); every other id returns 403 forbidden, which is what turns a sequential-id enumeration walk into a rising 403 share the classifier keys on.

get.summary: Get the calling customer's own profile
get.description: Returns the calling customer's own profile record. Used by the normal-client path of the demo to show ordinary, low-rate, low-error traffic that never trips the abuse classifier trigger.

get.summary: Get an order by id for the calling customer
get.description: Returns the order if it belongs to the calling customer identified by their x-api-key, otherwise returns 403 forbidden. In this demo only order id 1001 belongs to the caller; every other numeric id returns 403, which turns a sequential enumeration walk into a rising 403 share.
